**Overview:**  
Global Pacific Perunding Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited firm that provides management consulting services to small‑ and medium‑sized enterprises. It is incorporated in Perak since 15 January 2014 and has a paid‑up share capital of RM 500,000. The company is governed by three directors, with the second director owning the majority stake (58.7 %). No corporate shareholders are recorded and there are no court cases listed in the record.
